USB2.0 Male to RJ45 Console Cable RS232 – Cisco Compatible Network Configuration Cable

The USB2.0 Male to RJ45 Console Cable RS232 is a professional-grade solution for configuring and managing network equipment. Designed to convert a USB2.0 interface to an RJ45 console connection, it supports the RS232 serial communication protocol for stable and error-free data transfer. Ideal for IT engineers, this cable eliminates the need for bulky adapters while ensuring smooth console access to Cisco and other brands of devices.

Specifications:

  • Input: USB2.0 Male (backward compatible with USB1.1)
  • Output: RJ45 Male (console interface)
  • Communication Standard: RS232 Serial Protocol
  • Chipset: Built-in FTDI/Prolific serial chipset for reliable data transmission
  • Cable Length: Typically 1.5m / 2m (varies by model)
  • Data Transfer Rate: Up to 1 Mbps
  • Connector Material: Gold-plated connectors for stable signal
  • Cable Material: High-quality PVC jacket, flexible and durable
  • Operating Temperature: -10°C to 60°C
  • Storage Temperature: -20°C to 75°C
  • Compatibility: Cisco, Huawei, Juniper, TP-Link, Mikrotik, BDCom, and other network devices with RJ45 console ports
  • Driver Support: Windows XP/7/8/10/11, macOS, Linux
  • Plug & Play: No external power or additional adapters required
